answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit and build a checked work history before earning full trust. Like a canyon carved slowly, reputation should grow only from completed tasks. A prism of independent reviewers splits each claim into evidence, identity, and past performance, so one fake profile cannot pass every check at once. A cedar-like root record links the deposit to that history and is hard to forge. An attacker must fund and age many identities, lose deposits when caught, and repeat costly work for each fake, making mass fakery uneconomic.
